query:
UPDATE mcu_media SET 
  metaDescription = 'The Incredible Hulk (2008) complete guide — box office breakdown, cast spotlight, trading card market analysis, key cards to collect, and why this forgotten MCU chapter matters for collectors.',
  keywords = 'incredible hulk 2008, mcu phase 1, edward norton, bruce banner, marvel trading cards, rittenhouse hulk, abomination, thunderbolt ross, hulk cards',
  relatedCharacters = '["hulk", "bruce-banner", "abomination", "thunderbolt-ross", "betty-ross"]',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Topps Marvel Hulk cards',
  faqData = '[{"question": "Is The Incredible Hulk on Disney+?", "answer": "Yes, The Incredible Hulk was added to Disney+ in 2023 after Universal streaming rights expired. It is the second film in the MCU timeline."}, {"question": "Why was Edward Norton replaced as Hulk?", "answer": "Marvel Studios and Norton had creative differences over the film direction and editing. Norton wanted a darker, more character-driven film while Marvel prioritized action and MCU connectivity. Mark Ruffalo took over starting with The Avengers (2012)."}, {"question": "How much did The Incredible Hulk make at the box office?", "answer": "The Incredible Hulk grossed $264.8 million worldwide against a $150 million budget. It earned $55.4 million on its opening weekend. While profitable, it remains the lowest-grossing MCU film."}, {"question": "Is The Incredible Hulk connected to the MCU?", "answer": "Absolutely. Tony Stark appears in the post-credits scene, General Ross returns in Civil War and later films, The Leader returns in Captain America: Brave New World (2025), and Abomination appears in Shang-Chi and She-Hulk."}, {"question": "What Hulk trading cards are worth the most?", "answer": "Edward Norton autograph cards are extremely rare and valuable since he rarely signs. The 2008 Rittenhouse preview set (limited to 999) and Incredible Hulk #181 comic (first Wolverine appearance, $30,000+ in CGC 9.8) are top collectibles."}]'
WHERE slug = 'the-incredible-hulk-2008';
